correctness.rationale: Walnut identity reduces S to a three-diagonal integer-shift operator; the hat partition-of-unity proves A0+2A1=q. Exact summation on one 1/q cell yields the scalar Zak symbol q-D(x)(1-cos theta). Its extreme values give the exact frame bounds. A two-to-one quadratic map computes the density of D, an arcsine cosine law gives the conditional distribution, and an elementary beta integral gives both density branches. The shoulder expansion follows from arcsin near one; moments from the exact mean/variance of the quadratic transform; pure AC from null-set inverse images; and the scaled arcsine limit from uniform D/q convergence. Critical steps are infinite-dimensional proofs, independently of the 4068 finite executable checks. The exact normalization and endpoint domains are stated.
